Question:
I am considering an approved domestic remote location. What approval is required before changing my regular work location, and what personal-device conditions permit limited work access?

Retrieved context (grouped by document):
=== Document: HR-003 — Remote and Hybrid Work Policy ===

[Section: Cross-Border Work]
Chunk ID: 4d9b5b5a-6038-4f40-9321-f262d3aa7fd9
Score: 0.8088
Content:
Cross-Border Work

Northstar does not guarantee approval for work from any country. Temporary cross-border work requires People Operations review before travel. The company does not maintain a formal visa or immigration policy in the employee knowledge base.

Requests to work outside Canada or the United States are considered ambiguous until People Operations reviews tax, employment, and security implications.

[Section: Approval Requirements]
Chunk ID: 47b76ced-caf6-4234-b966-1a9cbde9e540
Score: 0.7567
Content:
Approval Requirements

Employees must receive manager approval before changing their regular work location. A temporary change within the same country for fewer than 15 business days may be approved by the manager. Longer changes require People Operations review.

Managers should consider team coverage, customer needs, time zone overlap, and data handling requirements before approving remote work.

[Section: Work Model]
Chunk ID: 4ec63d09-594a-4640-b1f7-5db5f5b9b238
Score: 0.7013
Content:
Work Model

Northstar supports hybrid work and approved remote work. Employees assigned to Toronto, Montreal, or New York offices are expected to attend office collaboration days when scheduled by their department.

Remote employees may work from approved locations in Canada or the United States if their role, tax location, and security requirements support remote work.

[Section: Not Covered]
Chunk ID: 73cda377-3fd2-4907-b799-92db1cc31555
Score: 0.6417
Content:
Not Covered

This policy does not provide legal advice, immigration advice, or guaranteed approval for international remote work.

[Section: Security Expectations]
Chunk ID: 47fe8690-3f57-4a00-99a4-17175db78840
Score: 0.6303
Content:
Security Expectations

Remote work must follow the Device and BYOD Security Policy and the Data Classification and Handling Policy. Confidential and restricted data may only be accessed on approved devices using company-approved tools.

[Section: Office Expectations]
Chunk ID: a72be1bf-5c00-44f0-bc47-135dfa3e3760
Score: 0.5544
Content:
Office Expectations

Hybrid teams should define collaboration days at least one month in advance. Employees should attend required team planning, onboarding, incident review, and customer workshop sessions in person when asked by their manager.

=== Document: IT-002 — Device and BYOD Security Policy ===

[Section: Remote Work]
Chunk ID: f021f971-ac5a-407f-adc5-e8abec25fd9d
Score: 0.6159
Content:
Remote Work

Remote work must follow this policy and the Remote and Hybrid Work Policy. Employees working remotely are responsible for using secure networks, avoiding shared public computers, and protecting screens from unauthorized viewing.

[Section: Personal Devices]
Chunk ID: 66a0bffd-898c-4c16-abf0-817b06af59d3
Score: 0.7866
Content:
Personal Devices

Personal devices may be used for limited work access only when enrolled in approved mobile device management or when access occurs through approved browser-based tools. Personal devices must use a passcode, supported operating system, and automatic lock.

Restricted data must not be downloaded to personal devices. Confidential data should be accessed only through approved company systems.

[Section: Company Devices]
Chunk ID: e63e8dbf-a320-4863-83cf-939dd76f89ca
Score: 0.6306
Content:
Company Devices

Employees who regularly access company systems should use a company-managed device. Company devices must have disk encryption, endpoint protection, automatic screen lock, and current operating system updates.

Employees may not disable security tools or remove device management controls from company devices.

=== Document: HR-001 — Employee Handbook ===

[Section: Related Policies]
Chunk ID: b6f7d058-c59b-40e2-bf9b-3a560a873391
Score: 0.5882
Content:
Related Policies

For time off, consult the PTO and Leave Policy. For remote work, consult the Remote and Hybrid Work Policy. For acceptable technology use, consult the Acceptable Use Policy.
